answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The nectar edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 195 clones produces a signature the relic analysis flags immediately. Anyone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the violet settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 25 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
